senses.gloss:
√kaṣ 'scratch'
present: [1.] kaṣati etc. AV.+ kaṣate etc. B.+ 
[perfect: cakāṣa akāṣīt ]
future: [1.] kaṣiṣyati -- [2.] kaṣitā 
verbal: kaṣita -kāṣam S.+ 
derivatives: kaṣa E.+ kaṣaṇa C. -kāṣa B.+ -kāṣin C.

√kas 'open'
present: [1.] kasati etc. 
perfect: cakase 
aorist: [3.] acīkasat 
[future: kasiṣyati kasitā ]
verbal: kasta kasita S.+ 
secondary: intensive: canīkas- -- desiderative: cikasiṣa- -- causative: kāsayati etc. kāsyate 
derivatives: kasanā? -kasuka AV.+ -kasti TS. -kasvara C. -kāsa E. -kāsaka C. -kāsin S.+ -kāsana C. -kāsanīya C.

√kāś 'appear, make a show'
present: [1.] kāśate etc. B.+ kāśati etc. 
perfect: cakāśe etc. E.+ -- kāśāṃ cakre 
[aorist: acakāśat akāśiṣṭa kāśiṣyate kāśitā ]
verbal: kāśita -kā́śya 
secondary: intensive: cākaśīti etc. cākaśyáte etc. -- desiderative: cikāśiṣa- -- causative: kāśayati AV.+ kāśayate U.+ kāśyate 
derivatives: kā́śa V.+ -kāśaka E.+ -kāśin E.+ -kāśya C. -kāśana E.+ -kāśanīya C. -caṅkaśa AV. -kāśayitavya C.

√kās 'cough'
present: [1.] kāsate etc. kāsati 
[perfect: kāsāṃ cakre acakāsat akāsiṣṭa kāsiṣyate kāsitā cākās- cikāsiṣa- kāsaya- ]
derivatives: kā́s kāsá AV.C. kāsā AV. kā́sikā AV. -kāsana C. 
derivatives: kā́s kāsá
